name: Aider Polyglot
intro: Aider Polyglot 从 C++、Go、Java、JavaScript、Python 和 Rust 六种语言的 697 道 Exercism 练习出发，让 7 个模型尝试全部题目，并保留仅被 0-3 个模型解出的 225 道难题。评测在 Docker 中运行 Aider 的端到端文件编辑与语言专用单元测试，同时报告正确完成题目百分比和正确编辑格式率。
build_method: Exercism 题库筛选、七模型难度预试、Docker 单元测试
metric: Percent Completed Correctly, Correct Edit Format Rate
task_type: 代码编辑, 代码生成
eval_feature: 多语言端到端代码编辑、编辑格式有效性、隔离单元测试
scale: 225 道困难编程练习，6 种语言（来自 697 道候选）
build_method_en: Exercism Task Filtering, Seven-Model Difficulty Probing, Docker Unit Tests
eval_feature_en: Multilingual End-to-End Code Editing, Edit-Format Validity, Isolated Unit Tests
intro_en: Aider Polyglot starts from 697 Exercism exercises in C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust, has seven models attempt every task, and retains the 225 exercises solved by only zero to three models. Evaluation runs Aider's end-to-end file editing and language-specific unit tests in Docker, reporting percent completed correctly and correct edit-format rate.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official Aider Polyglot announcement and the official Aider benchmark-harness README because no standalone paper exists. The diagram records all 697 Exercism exercises across C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, Python, and Rust; every one of seven models attempting every exercise; selection of the 225 tasks solved by zero to three models; exact per-language counts of 26, 39, 47, 49, 34, and 30; natural-language-to-file editing through Aider; isolated Docker execution; language-specific unit tests; and reporting of percent completed correctly plus correct edit-format or well-formed rate.
